scope: Final local Premium durable relay queue recovery hardening and Docker deployment.
authorization: Owner explicitly requested the local BROCCOLIQUEUE and BroccoliDB ingress queue, Docker image recreation/deployment, and an additional thorough resilience audit.

reconciled_stale_runtime.outcome: stopped cleanly after supervisor image-identity reconciliation

deployment.supervisor: existing local launch agent reloaded; running after exact image reconciliation

implementation_corrections: Already-claimed queue work retains readiness while graceful shutdown closes new public admission.
Periodic runtime refresh stops when drain begins; any in-flight sync is awaited before scheduler and execution cleanup.
Recovered waiting jobs are checked against their original absolute deadline at claim time before relay-handler entry; expired work returns not_accepted without provider dispatch.

The supervisor reloads the image manifest during reconciliation and requires both expected tag and immutable image ID. A healthy but stale runtime is gracefully drained and replaced after the existing ownership fence.

semantic_review.review_notes: Reviewed queue admission, idempotency, public response allowlists, artifact sanitation, storage permissions, claim lease/deadline recovery, graceful shutdown, database close ordering, supervisor manifest reconciliation, image identity, deployment and rollback boundaries. No provider request was sent; local tests and deployment checks are recorded separately.

limits: No provider generation was submitted by the operator; local acceptance does not qualify every provider/model/workload.
No public application cutover, account registration policy change or execution gate change occurred.
The queue is a single-installation local queue and is not a cross-host broker or cross-pool scheduler.
Queue contents are protected by local runtime ownership and file permissions but are not encrypted against host administrator or physical disk access.
An interrupted dispatched execution remains governed by the existing execution ledger and is not automatically redispatched after an uncertain outcome.
